definitions.explanation: A person who visits a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple to pray or pay their respects.

examples.japanese: {参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}が{列|れつ}を{作|つく}っていた。
{正月|しょうがつ}は{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}が{大勢|おおぜい}{訪|おとず}れる。
examples.english: Many worshippers visit during New Year's.

examples.japanese: この{神社|じんじゃ}は{年間|ねんかん}{百万人|ひゃくまんにん}の{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}を{集|あつ}める{有名|ゆうめい}な{場所|ばしょ}だ。
examples.english: This shrine is a famous place that attracts one million visitors a year.

notes:
Specifically refers to visitors at religious sites (shrines and temples), not general tourists or sightseers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {初詣|はつもうで}の{参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}: New Year's shrine visitors
- {参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}{数|すう}: number of worshippers
- {参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}{用|よう}の{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: parking lot for worshippers
- {参拝者|さんぱいしゃ}が{増|ふ}える: the number of visitors increases

RELATED WORDS:
- {参拝|さんぱい}する: to worship, to visit a shrine/temple
- {参拝|さんぱい}{客|きゃく}: shrine/temple visitors (synonym, using {客|きゃく} instead of {者|しゃ})
- {参詣|さんけい}: visiting a shrine or temple — more literary
- {初詣|はつもうで}: first shrine visit of the new year

FORMS:
{参拝|さんぱい} (worship, paying respects at a shrine) + {者|しゃ} (person).
